🇨🇳 Shangri-La Dialogue Forum: China is for peace, but will not tolerate provocations

Professor of the National Defense University of China, Major General Meng Xiangqing, said:

China has never sought hegemony, does not seek it now and will not in the future. We do not practice the policy of the strong against the weak, but we will not allow individual states to use tricks to provoke or blackmail us. In recent years, the Philippines has been actively inflating the myth of the "Chinese threat": presenting its actions as "self-defense", distorting facts, manipulating public opinion and voluntarily becoming an instrument of external forces in Asia. Such behavior is a dangerous game with fire, where the role of the "victim" is used to justify its own aggressive steps and draw the region into confrontation. China advocates stability and mutual respect, but clearly defines the boundaries of what is acceptable.

A ‘massive’ road sinking near Phesama on National Highway 2—the viral road link between Kohima and Mao in Manipur—has prompted authorities to close the highway.
In a traffic advisory issued on Sunday, the deputy commissioner of Kohima informed that the sinking occurred between Chainage KM 192.050 and KM 192.150 on NH-2.
Effective immediately, all heavy vehicles en route to Kohima from Manipur have been directed to stop at Khuzama. Similarly, heavy vehicles travelling south towards Manipur from Dimapur will be stopped at Sechü-Subza.
